items.claim: An explicit D8-discovered npm preview command started a disposable loopback server, changed to its announced port, restarted and stopped without installing dependencies.
Desktop, laptop, tablet and mobile viewport dimensions render through the D10 application-preview surface; this is not real-device qualification.
Installed local Playwright Chromium loaded the disposable application, captured a PNG and trace, collected bounded console/network evidence and terminated cleanly.
Console, runtime, network, screenshot and test-result scenarios are deterministic and redact fake credential-shaped values.
D4 proved Daytona signed preview and Playwright primitives; D10 does not promote those vendor links into a customer preview gateway.
D6 cloud gateway, D7 canonical snapshots and D10 Track B production diagnostics/artifacts remain unavailable.
